16294-england-in-america-1580-1652.creator: Lyon Gardiner Tyler, LL.D.
16294-england-in-america-1580-1652.description: A book by Lyon Gardiner Tyler, LL.D.. This book covers a period of a little more than three-quarters of a century. It begins with the first attempt at English colonization in America, in 1576, and ends with the year 1652, when the supremacy of Parliament was recognized throughout the English colonies.

54755-the-boy-scouts-of-woodcraft-camp.creator: Thornton W. Burgess
54755-the-boy-scouts-of-woodcraft-camp.description: A book by Thornton W. Burgess. tly gray, hoping to see the conductor or a brakeman, but he could see barely half the length of the next Pullman. A warning rumble at the head of the long train admonished him that he must act at once; he must make up his mind to stay or he must climb aboard again, and that quickly.

arxiv-2206-14521.title: Reconstruction of interactions in the ProtoDUNE-SP detector with Pandora Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2206-14521.creator: The DUNE Collaboration A. Abed Abud Liverpool,CERN, B. Abi Oxford, R. Acciarri Fermi, M. A. Acero Atlantico, M. R. Adames Tecnologica, G. Adamov Georgian, M. Adamowski Fermi, D. Adams Brookhaven, M. Adinolfi Bristol, C. Adriano Campinas, A. Aduszkiewicz Houston, J. Aguilar LawrenceBerkeley, Z. Ahmad
arxiv-2206-14521.description: Abstract The Pandora Software Development Kit and algorithm libraries provide pattern-recognition logic essential to the reconstruction of particle interactions in liquid argon time projection chamber detectors. Pandora is the primary event reconstruction software used at ProtoDUNE-SP, a prototype for the Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment far detector. ProtoDUNE-SP, located at CERN, is exposed to a charged-particle test beam.

arxiv-2208-14927.title: Experimental determination of the dissociative recombination rate coefficient for rotationally-cold CH + and its implications for the diffuse cloud chemistry
arxiv-2208-14927.creator: Daniel Paul, Manfred Grieser, Florian Grussie, Robert von Hahn, Leonard W. Isberner, Ábel Kálosi, Claude Krantz, Holger Kreckel, Damian Müll, David A. Neufeld, Daniel W. Savin, Stefan Schippers, Patrick Wilhelm, Andreas Wolf, Mark G. Wolfire, Oldřich Novotný
arxiv-2208-14927.description: Abstract Observations of CH + are used to trace the physical properties of diffuse clouds, but this requires an accurate understanding of the underlying CH + chemistry. Until this work, the most uncertain reaction in that chemistry was dissociative recombination (DR) of CH + .

arxiv-2303-05866.title: On Exams with the Isabelle Proof Assistant
arxiv-2303-05866.creator: Frederik Krogsdal Jacobsen Jørgen Villadsen
arxiv-2303-05866.description: Abstract We present an approach for testing student learning outcomes in a course on automated reasoning using the Isabelle proof assistant. The approach allows us to test both general understanding of formal proofs in various logical proof systems and understanding of proofs in the higher-order logic of Isabelle/HOL in particular.

arxiv-2307-08032.title: Nested Sequents for Quantified Modal Logics Thanks: Tim S. Lyon was supported by the European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant 771779 (DeciGUT).
arxiv-2307-08032.creator: Tim S. Lyon, Eugenio Orlandelli
arxiv-2307-08032.description: Abstract This paper studies nested sequents for quantified modal logics. In particular, it considers extensions of the propositional modal logics definable by the axioms D , T , B , 4 , and 5 with varying, increasing, decreasing, and constant domains.

arxiv-2509-01822.title: When LLM Meets Time Series: Can LLMs Perform Multi-Step Time Series Reasoning and Inference
arxiv-2509-01822.creator: Wen Ye, Jinbo Liu, Defu Cao, Wei Yang, Yan Liu
arxiv-2509-01822.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has sparked growing interest in their application to time series analysis tasks. However, their ability to perform complex reasoning over temporal data application domain remains significantly underexplored. To achieve the goal, one first step is to establish a rigorous benchmark dataset for evaluation.

arxiv-2510-17603.title: ShapeCraft: LLM Agents for Structured, Textured and Interactive 3D Modeling
arxiv-2510-17603.creator: Shuyuan Zhang Chenhan Jiang Zuoou Li Jiankang Deng
arxiv-2510-17603.description: Abstract 3D generation from natural language offers significant potential to reduce expert manual modeling efforts and enhance accessibility to 3D assets. However, existing methods often yield unstructured meshes and exhibit poor interactivity, making them impractical for artistic workflows. To address these limitations, we represent 3D assets as shape programs and introduce ShapeCraft, a novel multi-agent framework for text-to-3D generation.

pmc-10574418.title: Carbon Nanofibers Decorated by MoS2 Nanosheets with Tunable Quantity as Self-Supporting Anode for High-Performance Lithium Ion Batteries
pmc-10574418.creator: Liyan Dang, Yapeng Yuan, Zongyu Wang, Haowei Li, Rui Yang, Aiping Fu, Xuehua Liu, Hongliang Li, Henrich Frielinghaus
pmc-10574418.description: Two-dimensional molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) is considered as a highly promising anode material for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) due to its unique layer structure, large plane spacing, and high theoretical specific capacity; however, the overlap of MoS2 nanosheets and inherently low electrical conductivity lead to rapid capacity decay, resulting in poor cycling stability and low multiplicative performance.

pmc-10652460.title: Assembly, annotation and analysis of the chloroplast genome of the Algarrobo tree Neltuma pallida (subfamily: Caesalpinioideae)
pmc-10652460.creator: Esteban Caycho, Renato La Torre, Gisella Orjeda
pmc-10652460.description: Background Neltuma pallida is a tree that grows in arid soils in northwestern Peru. As a predominant species of the Equatorial Dry Forest ecoregion, it holds significant economic and ecological value for both people and environment. Despite this, the species is severely threatened and there is a lack of genetic and genomic research, hindering the proposal of evidence-based conservation strategies.

pmc-10689341.title: Mechanisms by which the intestinal microbiota affects gastrointestinal tumours and therapeutic effects
pmc-10689341.creator: Jikai He, Haijun Li, Jiaqi Jia, Yang Liu, Ning Zhang, Rumeng Wang, Wenhao Qu, Yanqi Liu, Lizhou Jia
pmc-10689341.description: The intestinal microbiota is considered to be a forgotten organ in human health and disease. It maintains intestinal homeostasis through various complex mechanisms. A significant body of research has demonstrated notable differences in the gut microbiota of patients with gastrointestinal tumours compared to healthy individuals.

pmc-11349664.title: The global incidence and trends of three common flavivirus infections (Dengue, yellow fever, and Zika) from 2011 to 2021
pmc-11349664.creator: Yuanhao Liang, Xingzhu Dai
pmc-11349664.description: BackgroundFlavivirus pose a continued threat to global health, yet their worldwide burden and trends remain poorly quantified. We aimed to evaluate the global, regional, and national incidence of three common flavivirus infections (Dengue, yellow fever, and Zika) from 2011 to 2021.

pmc-11395650.title: Crucial Interactions between Altered Plasma Trace Elements and Fatty Acids Unbalance Ratio to Management of Systemic Arterial Hypertension in Diabetic Patients: Focus on Endothelial Dysfunction
pmc-11395650.creator: Ines Gouaref, Amel Otmane, Mohamed Makrelouf, Samir Ait Abderrhmane, Ali El Mahdi Haddam, Elhadj-Ahmed Koceir, Silvia S Barbieri
pmc-11395650.description: The coexistence of SAH with T2DM is a common comorbidity. In this study, we investigated the link between altered plasma antioxidant trace elements (ATE: manganese, selenium, zinc, and copper) and fatty acids ratio (FAR: polyunsaturated/saturated) imbalance as transition biomarkers between vascular pathology (SAH) to metabolic pathology (T2DM).

pmc-11538600.title: Editorial: On the cusp of the silent wave of the long COVID pandemic: why, what and how should we tackle this emerging syndrome in the clinic and population?

pmc-11538600.description: post COVID-19 syndrome, post-acute COVID-19 syndrome, post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection, and persistent post-COVID-19 syndrome. Individuals with LC report experiencing many symptoms, including fatigue, post-exertional malaise (PEM), and sleep disturbances (2).

pmc-12386617.description: Certain environmental exposures are associated with COVID-19 incidence and mortality. To determine whether environmental context is associated with other COVID-19 experiences, we used data from the nationally representative Tufts Equity in Health, Wealth, and Civic Engagement Study data (n = 1785; three survey waves 2020–2022 for adults in the United States).

pmc-12578715.title: Clinicopathological features and prognosis of patients with colorectal Mucinous adenocarcinoma mixed with other pathological components: a nationwide retrospective study in China
pmc-12578715.creator: J Yuan, H He, P Zhang, X Guan, M Yu, Y Zhang, S Ning, L Wang, Y Lv, M Jiao, Y Sun, Q Sun, X Ren, D Liu, Z Zhang, Z Ye, J Li, G Yu, B Ma, W Fu, X H Kong, C Jing, K Tao, Y Sun, C Jiang, J Chen, G Zhang, H Yang
pmc-12578715.description: BackgroundMucinous adenocarcinoma (MAC) is typically admixed with other pathological components, including conventional adenocarcinoma, signet ring cell carcinoma, and/or neuroendocrine neoplasms. Specifically, signet ring cell differentiation (MASD) is defined as a signet ring cell component comprising less than 50% of the tumor, and neuroendocrine differentiation (MAND) is defined as a neuroendocrine component constituting less than 30%.

pmc-12652523.title: Oman Vision 2040: A Transformative Blueprint for a Leading Healthcare System with International Standards
pmc-12652523.creator: Mohammed Al Ghafari, Badar Al Alawi, Idris Aal Jumaa, Salah Al Awaidy
pmc-12652523.description: Background/Objectives: Oman Vision 2040, the national blueprint for socio-economic transformation, aims to elevate the Sultanate to developed nation status, with the “Health” priority committed to building a “Leading Healthcare System with International Standards” via a Health in All Policies (HiAP) approach.

pmc-13142180.title: Immediate post-denudation intracytoplasmic sperm injection is associated with higher fertilization and early cleavage-stage embryo yield: a prospective sibling-oocyte cohort from Libyan ICSI cycles
pmc-13142180.creator: Najwa A. Mahmoud, Muetaz M. Feetouri, Mohamed K. Elkawafi, Omar S. Alqabbasi, Mahmoud A. Aloriby, Tarek S. Bader, Yousef M. Hasen, Ali M. Milad, Mosaab S. Abdulkarim, Farag A. Bleiblo
pmc-13142180.description: Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) has become an integral practice in assisted reproduction technology (ART), but the optimal time interval between oocyte denudation (DN) and ICSI is still not well defined. Libya remains underrepresented in global fertility estimates, and prospective paired data on DN-to-ICSI timing from Libyan IVF practice are limited.

pmc-13658560.creator: Riccardo Garibaldi, Paolo Ivan Fiore, Seraina Rietschi, Jerome Cottet, Olivia Zbinden, Angela Seidel
pmc-13658560.description: BackgroundPlate exposure following open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) poses significant challenges, including infection risk and impaired fracture healing. Traditional management often involves aggressive surgical interventions.MethodsThis retrospective case series examines seven patients treated between 2020 and 2025 who developed plate exposure after ORIF of lower extremity fractures.
